tools.name: star-effects-diagnostic-20261012.json
tools.description: Inspect star effects for missing references, controller integration, repeated attachment targets and recorded firing conditions without changing the scene. Export a private diagnostic report, then verify suspected repairs in the built avatar and emulator before claiming success.
tools.command_template: Install the reviewed editor source set described in docs/avatar-effects-editor-tools-20261012.md; then open Tools/Unity Unicorn/star-effects-diagnostic (read only).
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with the intended avatar project and its legitimately acquired asset dependencies.
Review the source and keep a recoverable project baseline before applying changes.
limitations: Editor source preview; standalone compilation is not Unity or VRChat runtime verification.
Private learned templates, third-party assets and actual use records are not bundled.
